feature: Reusable saved workflow group
observed: The same saved local workflow group was reused across runs 4064, 4065 and 4066. The published manual-only 10-node definition retained its group ID while replacement panels explicitly linked to it.
recommendation: Future user panels must explicitly link to this existing group; offline panels receive no commands.

feature: Workflow Customer → Note → Opportunity saved end to end
observed: Run 4066 completed all 10 nodes. The workflow alone filled and saved Customer, Note and Opportunity. Three HTTP 200 host POSTs matched three exact records independently read from the host records page. No observer host fill, Save click or direct record write.
recommendation: Retain the full UI journey and exact independent readback. This proves these three synthetic records, not arbitrary business-system success.

feature: Live Save execution after classification correction
observed: All three native Save nodes executed through exact owner-reviewed local bindings under the internal-write policy. The preceding fill steps used the explicitly approved, workflow-specific three-use temporary grant. No visitor review-button click was performed.
recommendation: Keep visitor review and autonomous workflow authority distinct. A binding is not a general permission to save; each effect still requires policy authorization.

feature: Temporary UAT grant cleanup

Independent readback confirms zero overrides for this workflow; company internal writes remain autonomous, external messages require approval, and destructive actions remain prohibited.
recommendation: Future runs must satisfy current policy again; this UAT grant is no longer available.

observed: The status serializer now whitelists recipient status and opaque result handles. A canary verifies exclusion before/after execution and after task end. The real isolated platform-runner regression checks stored output_json excludes private effect values.

feature: Broad generic intelligent UI-agent coverage
observed: Seven representative live intent cases now pass with global maker/checker enabled. Ten DOM/framework checks and the earlier three-form saved workflow also pass. This does not establish unrestricted browser-agent parity on arbitrary websites.
recommendation: Expand independent ambiguity, recovery, browser/device and latency evaluations before broadening autonomy. Model agreement never replaces authorization or persisted host readback.

feature: Global admin enable/disable and persistent default
observed: The real Admin UI enables review for all website copilots, retains it after reload, and restores maker-only when disabled. Maker-only persisted through the later service B/platform C deployment. Isolated real API tests reject anonymous/CEO writes, malformed settings and secret/model overrides.
recommendation: Keep the default Off until an administrator intentionally enables the selected available checker. Existing visitor approvals and Action Policies remain mandatory.

feature: Independent maker/checker roles and live website coverage
observed: All seven visitor intent cases pass on public flolah.cloud and the loopback fixture while review is enabled. Gateway metadata confirms active secondary as maker and inactive primary as checker. Slot-swap regression verifies the reverse configuration.
recommendation: Use the inactive platform-slot checker on this deployment. Seven sequential samples are not a concurrent capacity benchmark.

feature: One bounded revision and final recheck
observed: Two of the seven real model operations requested one maker revision and then accepted the corrected proposal. Regression coverage also proves repeated disagreement stops after one revision with no actions.
recommendation: Retain the bounded revision and final deterministic contract checks; do not infer host completion from a judge verdict.

feature: Clarification, rejection and checker failure stop changes
observed: Checker clarify/reject returns no actions. Missing or malformed checker responses fail closed. The real local-checker timeout surfaced COPILOT_CHECKER_UNAVAILABLE, left the field unchanged and made zero host submissions.
recommendation: Keep explicit no-change errors. No unreviewed maker fallback is allowed while global review is enabled.

feature: Shortcut coverage and visitor override denial
observed: Explicit field and navigation proposals consult the current gateway policy instead of bypassing review. Disabled shortcuts require no model inference. Gateway tests reject visitor-supplied model/review overrides and invalid live choices.
recommendation: Preserve the server-side policy boundary and current control revalidation.

feature: Knowledge/private-task answer review contract
observed: Gateway integration verifies knowledge responses require the checker and rejected claims become insufficient without citations. Private task summaries use this same knowledge adapter; existing task-grounding and deletion regressions remain in the full suite. This row is contract coverage, not a new live OCR scenario.
recommendation: Retain website/task-scoped evidence and citation verification; extend live attachment benchmarks independently.

feature: Local Ollama reasoning returns an accepted live verdict
observed: With the registered deepseek-r1:8b checker selected through Admin, an explicit synthetic Express proposal returned HTTP 503 after 38,163 ms. No accepted verdict was obtained. The field stayed unchanged and host writes were zero. The raw route record describes partial route coverage; this acceptance criterion failed.
recommendation: Use the verified inactive-slot checker for now. Evaluate local-model latency/capacity or a suitable registered reasoning model before enabling the local route for visitors.

feature: Local reasoning transport and admission bounds
observed: The local route resolves the registered reasoning deployment, requests native JSON/thinking output, excludes reasoning traces, disallows hosted fallback and limits concurrent local checks. Transport, slot release, invalid output and global policy tests pass.
recommendation: Keep the per-gateway concurrency budget aligned with the inference host; additional replicas multiply that budget.

feature: Restored platform-wide Digital Adoption websites page
observed: Admin navigation now opens /admin/digital-adoption. The actual service lists all three existing registrations under their one current owner. The local fixture and both original/isolated Flolah registrations are visible. No live registrations were seeded.
recommendation: Use this platform overview for cross-owner administration; website-owner sign-in remains scoped to that owner.

feature: Cross-owner paging, search and safe inventory projection
observed: Isolated tests register 130 synthetic entries across two owners and verify paging past 100, owner/domain search, status filters and rejection of non-admin or spoofed-role access. Inventory excludes DNS challenges, credentials, action bindings and task/document data.
recommendation: Retain server-side role checks and bounded pagination. Current live data contains one owner; two-owner coverage is isolated test evidence.

feature: Selected registration management and filter usability
observed: Live UI filters find one local registration, two Flolah registrations and no pending matches. Manage website opens the authorized local registration directly with its separate embedding selected. The selected-ID path also works beyond the legacy list cap in regression.
recommendation: Keep indexes and visitor controls registration-specific. Installation counts are issued credentials, not online visitor counts.
